conclusion: The measured residual is material enough that an allocation-only speedup cannot be inferred. Keep the current buffers; defer a zero-allocation reject-path patch as unmeasured, not exhausted.
residual_interpretation: Upper bound on allocation plus seed setup, loop/bookkeeping, fine-grain profiler/clock overhead and other work outside measured top-level stages. It is not an allocation-only estimate.

static_allocation_audit.allocations_before_later_rejection: Compact native processing allocates discovery-copy storage and a per-seed NBAnchor output buffer before later structure screening can reject the seed; therefore reject paths are not allocation-free.
static_allocation_audit.instrumentation: No production native source was modified for allocation counting; exact nb_alloc calls per input remain unmeasured.
static_allocation_audit.lazy_buffers: Structure point copies, mansion ids, nether raw/viable buffers, palette/biome buffers and final anchor storage allocate when their stages need them.
static_allocation_audit.reused_per_worker: scratch and flags buffers are retained and grown through nb_reserve; generator/context is reused per worker during a native call; mansion cache is reset per input.
